verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is documented as a serverless framework that runs backend code in response to HTTPS requests and the Admin SDK. Code deploys from the CLI with one command, and Firebase scales compute automatically, so there are no servers to manage. Local emulation is supported, and community users mention using Functions as part of the platform. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of client-SDK callable invocation, and independent hands-on corroboration of HTTP/SDK-invoked deployments beyond passing mentions.
